body.input: Which health tech companies opened an office in Norway in 2026?

response.content:
I was unable to find specific reports of health tech companies that opened a new office in Norway in 2026. While Norway has a vibrant health technology ecosystem — with over 350 organizations in the Norway Health Tech cluster and events such as the Healthtech Festival 2026 in Stavanger and the "Entering Norway: Meet the Health Ecosystem" initiative aimed at attracting Nordic companies — no concrete announcements of individual health tech companies opening new offices in Norway during 2026 surfaced in available sources.

If you are tracking this topic, the Norway Health Tech cluster (norwayhealthtech.com) and its member portal may be useful resources, as they actively track new entrants and members in the Norwegian health technology market.
